hand_at_mouth.text: A hand comes to the front of the mouth and stays there.
hand_at_mouth.definition: A hand moves to directly in front of the mouth, at the center of the lower face, and stays there for at least a short pause. A hand at the ear, forehead or top of the head does not count.

both_hands_at_face.text: Both hands are at the front of the face at the same time.
both_hands_at_face.definition: Both hand joints are at the front of the face, around the eyes, nose or cheeks, together for at least a moment.

hand_beside_head.text: A hand is at the side of the head near the ear, temple or side of the forehead.
hand_beside_head.definition: A hand is at head height at the side of the head (next to the ear, the temple or the side of the forehead), not in front of the mouth and not on top of the head.

hand_on_head_top.text: A hand reaches the top of the head.
hand_on_head_top.definition: A hand joint reaches the crown of the head, above the ears, at some point in the action, whether it moves onto the head or starts there and moves away.

hands_touch_each_other.text: The two hands of the same person touch each other.
hands_touch_each_other.definition: The right and left hand joints of the same person meet or overlap in front of the body at some point. Crossed forearms with the hands apart do not count.

hand_on_own_chest.text: A hand rests against the front of the person's own chest or stomach.
hand_on_own_chest.definition: One or both hands rest on the front of the same person's chest or stomach, touching the torso, rather than being held in front of it.

single_arm_active.text: Only one arm carries the motion while the other arm stays still.
single_arm_active.definition: One arm (usually the right) makes the main movement while the other arm stays at the side or nearly still, and the legs do not carry the motion.

both_arms_symmetric.text: Both arms make the same motion at the same time as mirror images.
both_arms_symmetric.definition: The left and right arms move together along matching, left-right mirrored paths for most of the action.

asymmetric_hand_roles.text: One hand stays still as a base while the other hand moves near or onto it.
asymmetric_hand_roles.definition: Both hands are close together in front of the body; one hand (usually the left) stays nearly still while the other hand makes repeated or directed movements near it or onto it.

wrist_hand_dominant.text: The motion is mainly at the wrists and hands while the upper arms stay still.
wrist_hand_dominant.definition: The visible motion is mainly in the hand and wrist joints, while the elbows and shoulders stay nearly fixed.

head_carries_motion.text: The head is the main moving part.
head_carries_motion.definition: The largest visible movement is the head moving relative to the shoulders (nodding, turning left and right, or tilting toward a shoulder), while the arms stay passive or move less.

legs_carry_motion.text: The legs carry the main motion.
legs_carry_motion.definition: The largest movement is in the knees, ankles and feet (bending together, alternating, or one leg moving), with the arms only following or balancing.

arm_extends_forward.text: An arm straightens so the hand ends far in front of the body.
arm_extends_forward.definition: The elbow extends until the arm is nearly straight and the hand is held at almost full arm length in front of the shoulder.

fast_arm_swing.text: An arm draws back and then swings quickly through a long path.
fast_arm_swing.definition: The arm first moves back or up, then swings fast from the shoulder through a long forward, downward or sideways path, often followed through past the body.

downward_press.text: A hand or foot pushes sharply downward.
downward_press.definition: A hand or foot moves down quickly toward a low point (the other hand, a low spot in front, or the floor) and stops there.

hand_retracts_to_body.text: A hand reaches out and is then pulled back toward the person's own body.
hand_retracts_to_body.definition: After reaching out or down, a hand moves back toward the same person's torso, and this return is a main phase of the action rather than just lowering the arm.

hands_come_together.text: The two hands move toward each other and end close together.
hands_come_together.definition: During the main phase the distance between the two hands shrinks, ending with the hands close or touching.

hands_move_apart.text: The two hands start together and move apart.
hands_move_apart.definition: The hands begin close together and the distance between them grows during the main phase.

repeated_short_strokes.text: A hand moves back and forth along a short path many times.
repeated_short_strokes.definition: A hand moves back and forth along a short line repeatedly, either by swinging the forearm at the elbow while the upper arm stays fixed, or by sliding against the body or the other hand.

torso_bent_forward.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
torso_bent_forward.definition: The spine leans forward from the hips so the shoulders are ahead of the hips, often with the shoulders rounded inward.

head_bowed_toward_hands.text: The head tilts down toward the hands and stays down.
head_bowed_toward_hands.definition: The head tilts down and forward toward the hands or the floor, closing the gap to the hands, and stays lowered for much of the action.

head_tilted_back.text: The head tips backward so the face turns up.
head_tilted_back.definition: The head tilts backward relative to the neck so the face turns upward, sometimes with the upper torso also leaning back.

seated.text: The person is sitting with the hips at seat height.
seated.definition: For at least part of the action the hips are low at seat height, the knees are bent and the thighs are roughly horizontal, with the feet on the floor.

elbow_raised_high.text: An elbow is lifted out to the side to about shoulder height or higher.
elbow_raised_high.definition: The elbow joint is raised out to the side of the body to about shoulder height or above, rather than pointing down or forward.

torso_twists.text: The shoulders turn relative to the hips.
torso_twists.definition: The line of the shoulders rotates around the vertical axis relative to the line of the hips, usually together with an arm movement.

hand_upright.text: A raised hand is held upright with the hand tip and thumb above the wrist.
hand_upright.definition: A hand raised in front of or beside the body is held with the hand tip and thumb joints above the wrist joint during the hold.

many_steady_repeats.text: The same movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
many_steady_repeats.definition: One short movement cycle is repeated many times in a row at a roughly constant rhythm through most of the action.

single_occurrence.text: The main movement happens once and does not repeat.
single_occurrence.definition: The main movement is performed one time from start to finish, with no repeated cycles.

raise_hold_lower.text: A limb rises to a pose, holds it still briefly, then returns.
raise_hold_lower.definition: An arm (or both) rises to a target position, stays nearly still there for a short pause with no repeated strokes, then lowers back.

long_hold.text: The key position is held for most of the clip.
long_hold.definition: The key position is reached early and kept with little change for most of the action, rather than only a short pause.

sudden_fast_motion.text: The main movement starts abruptly and is very fast.
sudden_fast_motion.definition: The main movement, or a short jerk of the head or torso, starts abruptly and is clearly faster than the rest of the action.

continuous_small_hand_motion.text: Small hand movements continue through the whole action.
continuous_small_hand_motion.definition: The hands keep making small movements without pause for the whole action, while the arms and body stay mostly in place.

one_side_then_other.text: A movement is done on one side of the body, then on the other side.
one_side_then_other.definition: One arm or side of the body performs a movement, and then the other arm or side performs a similar movement, in sequence rather than together.

walks_across_floor.text: The person walks so the body travels across the floor.
walks_across_floor.definition: The legs take alternating steps and the hips move to a clearly different place on the floor.

legs_cycle_in_place.text: The legs lift and land repeatedly while the body stays on the same spot.
legs_cycle_in_place.definition: The feet repeatedly lift off and land and the whole body bobs up and down, but the hips do not travel across the floor.

airborne.text: Both feet leave the floor at some moment.
airborne.definition: At some moment both feet are off the floor at the same time and the whole body is in the air.

hips_lower.text: The hips move down toward the floor.
hips_lower.definition: The knees and hips bend deeply and the hips move down toward the floor, ending in a crouch, on a seat, or on the floor.

hips_rise.text: The hips rise from a low position toward standing.
hips_rise.definition: Starting with the knees and hips bent and the hips low, the legs straighten and the hips move up toward standing height.

on_one_leg.text: The body is supported on one leg while the other leg lifts or moves.
on_one_leg.definition: For part of the action one foot is off the floor and the body balances on the other leg, while the lifted leg is held up, kicks out or swings.

unsteady_sway.text: The body sways or loses balance.
unsteady_sway.definition: The torso and hips sway or tip in irregular directions and the feet land unevenly, as when the body loses balance.

hands_above_head.text: One or both hands rise above the top of the head.
hands_above_head.definition: At some point one or both hand joints are higher than the top of the head.

hands_together_at_chest.text: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest.
hands_together_at_chest.definition: Both hands are near each other at chest height, in front of the torso near the midline, for the main part of the action.

hands_low_in_front.text: The active hands are low in front of the body at about waist height.
hands_low_in_front.definition: The hands doing the main work are in front of the body at or below waist height, roughly at table height, not at the chest.

hands_down_to_feet.text: The hands reach down to the feet or the floor.
hands_down_to_feet.definition: One or both hand joints lower to about the height of the knees or below, near the feet or the floor in front of the body.

hands_behind_torso.text: A hand moves behind the back or behind the shoulders.
hands_behind_torso.definition: A hand joint moves to a position behind the plane of the person's own torso, at the lower back, upper back or behind a shoulder.

hand_at_own_hip.text: A hand goes to the side of the person's own hip or upper thigh.
hand_at_own_hip.definition: A hand moves to the side of the same person's hip or upper thigh, or just behind it at the lower back, and stays there briefly, rather than in front of the body.

one_hand_raised_front.text: A single hand is raised in front of the body between chest and shoulder height.
one_hand_raised_front.definition: One hand is lifted with the elbow bent to between chest and shoulder height in front of the body, without reaching the face and without the arm straightening.

hand_crosses_midline.text: A hand moves across to the opposite side of the body.
hand_crosses_midline.definition: A hand passes the body's midline and works on the opposite side, including when the two forearms cross over each other in front of the chest or face.

arms_out_to_sides.text: The arms are held or swung out to the sides of the body.
arms_out_to_sides.definition: The hands are clearly out to the side of the shoulders, away from the sides of the torso, for part of the action.

beside_or_behind_partner.text: One person stands beside or behind the other rather than face to face.
beside_or_behind_partner.definition: During the main phase the actor is at the side of or behind the partner, so their torsos do not face each other.

hands_meet_between.text: A hand of each person meets the other's in the space between them.
hands_meet_between.definition: A hand of each person reaches forward so the two hands touch or nearly touch midway between the two bodies, usually briefly, before being pulled back.

partner_recoils.text: The partner's body jerks, leans or steps back away from the actor.
partner_recoils.definition: Right after the actor's movement, the partner's head or torso moves back or turns away suddenly, or the partner steps backward.

partner_raises_arms.text: The partner lifts the arms in front of the head or chest.
partner_raises_arms.definition: In response to the actor's movement, the partner raises one or both arms so the forearms are in front of the head or chest.

distance_decreases.text: The two people move closer together.
distance_decreases.definition: The distance between the two torsos clearly shrinks during the action.

distance_increases.text: The two people end farther apart than they started.
distance_increases.definition: The distance between the two torsos clearly grows during the action, because one or both walk away or the partner steps back.

sustained_contact.text: The two people stay in contact for a long time.
sustained_contact.definition: A joint of one person stays touching the other person's body for much of the action, rather than a brief touch.

walk_same_direction.text: Both people walk in the same direction.
walk_same_direction.definition: Both skeletons travel across the floor in the same direction at a similar speed, keeping a steady distance apart.

both_same_motion.text: Both people make the same movement at the same time.
both_same_motion.definition: The two skeletons perform matching movements at the same time, rather than one person acting while the other stays still or only reacts.

touches_partner_upper_body.text: The actor's hand touches the partner's head, shoulders, chest or upper back.
touches_partner_upper_body.definition: The actor's hand reaches the partner's body above the waist (head, shoulder, chest or upper back).

touches_partner_lower_body.text: The actor's hand or foot touches the partner's hip, legs or feet.
touches_partner_lower_body.definition: The actor's hand or foot reaches the partner's body at hip level or below.

knee_lifts_forward.text: While standing on one leg, the other thigh swings up in front so the knee rises ahead of the hip.
knee_lifts_forward.definition: From a standing support on one foot, the thigh of the other leg swings up in front of the body so the knee joint rises clearly forward of and up toward the height of the hip, with the ankle below or in front of the knee, and then lowers again. A knee that bends only to bring the heel up behind the body while the thigh stays vertical does not count, and thighs that become horizontal only because the hips lower onto a seat do not count.

drink_water.text: a person raises one hand to the mouth and tilts the head back
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to the lips and leans the head back
a person brings one hand up to the mouth while the head tips backward
a person holds the right hand at the mouth and tilts the head upward briefly
drink_water.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises from waist level to the mouth. The head tilts backward while the hand stays near the mouth for a moment. The hand then lowers back down to the front of the body and the head returns upright.

phases.start: right hand rises from waist toward mouth
phases.middle: hand held at mouth, head tilted back

eat_meal.text: a person repeatedly moves one hand from the table area to the mouth
paraphrases: a person brings the right hand up to the mouth again and again
a person makes several trips with one hand between the lap and the mouth
a person, usually seated, lifts a hand to the mouth repeatedly while leaning slightly forward
eat_meal.motion: The person, often seated, keeps the torso slightly forward. The right hand moves from in front of the body near waist height up to the mouth and back down, repeating several times. The head may dip slightly toward the hand each time; the left hand stays low in front of the body.

phases.start: hands low in front of body
phases.middle: repeated hand-to-mouth trips
phases.end: hand rests low in front of body

brush_teeth.text: a person holds one hand at the mouth moving it quickly side to side
paraphrases: a person keeps the right hand near the mouth with fast small back-and-forth motion
a person rubs one hand back and forth in front of the mouth repeatedly
a person makes rapid short horizontal hand motions held at the level of the mouth
brush_teeth.motion: The right arm bends sharply and the right hand rises to the mouth. The hand stays at the mouth and moves quickly in short side-to-side or up-and-down strokes many times. The elbow stays raised out to the side, and the head stays mostly still; at the end the hand lowers.

phases.start: right hand rises to mouth
phases.middle: fast repeated small strokes at the mouth

brush_hair.text: a person repeatedly moves one hand over the top and side of the head
paraphrases: a person sweeps the right hand along the head from front to back repeatedly
a person raises one hand above the head and strokes downward several times
a person makes repeated combing strokes with one raised hand along the head
brush_hair.motion: The right arm lifts with the elbow raised high and the hand placed at the top or side of the head. The hand moves from the top of the head down and back toward the neck or shoulder, then returns up, repeating several times. The head may tilt slightly toward the brushing side.

phases.start: right hand rises to top of head
phases.middle: repeated downward strokes along the head

drop.text: a person opens a held hand in front of the body letting something fall
paraphrases: a person holds one hand out in front and then releases, with little arm motion
a person extends the right hand forward and lets go, then lowers the arm
a person releases something from one hand at waist height and looks down after it
drop.motion: The right hand is held in front of the body at about waist or chest height. The arm stays nearly still while the hand opens, and the head often tilts down to look at the floor. The arm then lowers to the side; the person does not bend down.

phases.start: hand held out in front of the body
phases.middle: hand opens, head looks down

pick_up.text: a person bends down to reach the floor and then straightens up
paraphrases: a person leans forward and lowers one hand to the ground, then stands upright
a person bends the torso and knees, reaches down, and rises again
a person stoops to bring a hand near the feet before returning to standing
pick_up.motion: From standing, the torso bends forward and the knees bend so the hips lower. The right arm extends down until the hand is near the floor in front of the feet. The person then straightens the knees and torso, bringing the hand back up to the front of the body.

phases.start: standing upright
phases.middle: torso bent, hand near the floor
phases.end: standing again with hand in front of body

throw.text: a person swings one arm from behind the shoulder forward and releases quickly
paraphrases: a person draws the right arm back and then whips it forward fast
a person cocks one hand behind the head and snaps the arm forward
a person pulls an arm back then extends it rapidly forward while stepping forward
throw.motion: The right arm draws back so the hand is behind and above the right shoulder, and the torso rotates slightly to the right. The arm then swings quickly forward and extends, while the torso turns forward and weight shifts onto the front foot. The arm follows through downward and returns to the side.

phases.start: arm drawn back behind shoulder
phases.middle: fast forward swing and arm extension

sit_down.text: a person lowers the hips from standing to a seated position
paraphrases: a person bends the knees and hips and settles into a seat
a person goes from upright standing to sitting with the hips lowered
a person leans slightly forward and lowers the hips down into a seated position
sit_down.motion: From standing, the person bends the knees and hips while the torso leans slightly forward. The hips move backward and down until they stop at seat height. The torso then returns upright with the thighs roughly horizontal and the feet staying on the floor.

phases.start: standing upright
phases.middle: knees and hips bend, hips move down and back

stand_up.text: a person rises from a seated position to standing upright
paraphrases: a person leans forward and straightens the legs to get up from sitting
a person lifts the hips up from a seat until fully standing
a person goes from sitting with bent knees to standing with straight legs
stand_up.motion: The person starts seated with knees bent and hips low. The torso leans forward, the hands may push down near the thighs, and the knees and hips extend to raise the hips. The torso returns upright and the person ends standing with straight legs.

phases.start: seated with knees bent
phases.middle: torso leans forward, hips rise

clapping.text: a person repeatedly brings both hands together in front of the chest
paraphrases: a person strikes the two palms together several times at chest height
a person moves both hands apart and together again and again in front
a person claps by bringing the hands together repeatedly in front of the body
clapping.motion: Both arms bend so the hands are in front of the chest. The hands move apart sideways a short distance and then come together to touch, repeating many times at a steady rhythm. The elbows stay near the torso and the rest of the body stays still.

phases.start: both hands rise to chest height
phases.middle: repeated meeting and separating of the hands

reading.text: a person holds both hands still in front of the chest with head bowed
paraphrases: a person keeps both hands together at chest height while looking down at them
a person stays mostly still with hands held in front and the head tilted down
a person holds the hands in front of the body and occasionally moves one sideways
reading.motion: Both forearms are raised so the hands are held close together in front of the chest or lap. The head tilts down toward the hands and stays there. The body is mostly still; occasionally one hand makes a short sideways sweep and returns.

phases.start: hands rise to the front of the chest
phases.middle: hands held still, head bowed toward them
phases.end: occasional short hand sweep or hands lower

writing.text: a person makes small continuous movements with one hand held low in front
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand in small strokes while the left hand stays still
a person leans over and moves one hand slowly across a surface in front
a person keeps the head bowed while the right hand makes short repeated movements
writing.motion: The person, often seated, leans the torso slightly forward with the head bowed. The right hand is held low in front of the body and makes small continuous movements, shifting gradually sideways. The left hand stays still nearby, and the rest of the body barely moves.

phases.start: hands placed low in front, head bows
phases.middle: right hand makes small continuous strokes

tear_up_paper.text: a person holds both hands together in front then pulls them sharply apart
paraphrases: a person brings two hands close at chest height and jerks them in opposite directions
a person repeatedly pulls the hands apart from each other in front of the chest
a person grips with both hands together then twists them away from each other
tear_up_paper.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest. One hand moves forward or up and the other moves back or down in a quick tearing motion, separating the hands slightly. The hands come together again and the motion repeats a few times, with the elbows bent and close to the body.

phases.start: hands meet in front of the chest
phases.middle: repeated quick pulling apart of the hands

put_on_jacket.text: a person reaches one arm then the other backward behind the body
paraphrases: a person swings each arm back and down behind the body, one at a time
a person reaches back with one arm, then the other, and pulls shoulders forward
a person extends arms behind the body in turn and shrugs the shoulders up
put_on_jacket.motion: One hand holds near the opposite shoulder while the other arm reaches down and backward behind the body, then extends forward. The first hand moves across behind the back and the second arm reaches back in the same way. The shoulders shrug and both hands pull forward at the chest at the end.

phases.start: one arm reaches back and down
phases.middle: second arm reaches back behind the body
phases.end: shoulders shrug, hands pull at the front of the chest

take_off_jacket.text: a person pulls the shoulders back and draws each arm forward from behind
paraphrases: a person pushes the shoulders back then pulls one arm forward, then the other
a person reaches across to the opposite shoulder and slides each arm out in turn
a person brings both arms behind the back and frees them one after another
take_off_jacket.motion: Both hands go to the front of the chest and then to the shoulders, and the shoulders roll back. One arm straightens down and backward, then pulls forward while the other hand holds behind the back. The second arm then pulls forward and both hands come to the front of the body.

phases.start: hands at chest and shoulders
phases.middle: arms drawn back and pulled out one at a time
phases.end: both hands in front of the body

put_on_a_shoe.text: a person bends down and works with both hands at one foot
paraphrases: a person leans forward, lifts one foot, and moves both hands around it
a person brings both hands down to one foot and pushes the foot forward
a person, often seated, holds one foot with two hands and pulls upward
put_on_a_shoe.motion: The person, often seated, bends the torso forward and raises or bends one leg. Both hands reach down to that foot and hold near it, making pulling motions upward toward the ankle. The foot pushes forward and down, then the person sits back up and lowers the foot.

phases.start: torso bends and hands reach to one foot
phases.middle: hands pull around the foot while foot pushes forward

take_off_a_shoe.text: a person bends to one foot and pulls with both hands away from it
paraphrases: a person leans forward, grips near one foot, and draws the hands off it
a person lifts one foot slightly and pulls downward and away with both hands
a person, often seated, reaches to one ankle and pulls the hands away
take_off_a_shoe.motion: The person, often seated, bends the torso forward and lifts or bends one leg. Both hands reach down to the heel area of that foot, then pull down and away from the foot while the leg draws back. The person straightens up and the hands come back up in front.

phases.start: torso bends and hands reach the foot
phases.middle: hands pull away while leg draws back

put_on_glasses.text: a person brings both hands up to the sides of the face
paraphrases: a person raises two hands to the eyes and slides them back to the ears
a person lifts both hands before the face and moves them toward the temples
a person brings hands from the chest to the face, holding them near the ears
put_on_glasses.motion: Both hands rise from in front of the chest toward the face, close together in front of the eyes. The hands then move apart and backward along the sides of the head toward the ears, and the head may tilt slightly forward. The hands then lower back down.

phases.start: both hands rise toward the face
phases.middle: hands move from the eyes back to the ears

take_off_glasses.text: a person raises hands to the sides of the face and pulls forward
paraphrases: a person lifts both hands to the temples and draws them forward and away
a person brings hands up near the ears then moves them out in front
a person reaches to the face with two hands and lowers them forward and down
take_off_glasses.motion: Both hands rise to the sides of the head near the ears or temples. The hands move forward past the eyes and away from the face, coming together in front. The hands then lower to chest height or below.

phases.start: hands rise to the sides of the head
phases.middle: hands move forward away from the eyes
phases.end: hands lower in front of the chest

put_on_a_hat_cap.text: a person raises both hands above the head and lowers them onto it
paraphrases: a person lifts two hands over the head and presses down on top of it
a person brings both hands up to the top of the head and adjusts there
a person reaches above the head with both hands and pulls them down to it
put_on_a_hat_cap.motion: Both arms lift so the hands are above the head. The hands move down to rest on top of the head, sometimes pulling down at the front and back. The head may tilt forward slightly, and then both hands lower to the sides.

phases.start: both hands rise above the head
phases.middle: hands lower onto the top of the head and press

take_off_a_hat_cap.text: a person raises a hand to the top of the head and lifts it away
paraphrases: a person reaches up to the top of the head and pulls the hand upward
a person brings a hand onto the head then raises it and lowers it forward
a person lifts a hand off the top of the head and lowers it in front
take_off_a_hat_cap.motion: The right hand, sometimes with the left, rises to the top of the head. The hand then moves up and slightly forward away from the head. The arm then lowers so the hand ends in front of the chest or at the side.

phases.start: hand rises to the top of the head
phases.middle: hand lifts up and away from the head
phases.end: hand lowers in front of the body

cheer_up.text: a person raises both arms high above the head in celebration
paraphrases: a person throws both arms straight up over the head and holds them
a person lifts two arms upward above the shoulders, sometimes pumping them
a person extends both arms overhead and often moves them up and down
cheer_up.motion: Both arms rise quickly from the sides to above the head with the elbows straightening. The arms stay raised and may pump up and down a few times, and the torso may lean back slightly or bounce. The arms then lower to the sides.

phases.start: arms rise quickly from the sides
phases.middle: arms held or pumped above the head

hand_waving.text: a person raises one hand and swings it side to side repeatedly
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to head height and moves it left and right
a person holds one forearm up and sways the hand back and forth
a person waves by moving a raised hand from side to side several times
hand_waving.motion: The right arm lifts with the elbow bent so the hand is at or above head height, out to the side. The forearm and hand swing left and right repeatedly while the upper arm stays mostly still. The arm then lowers to the side.

phases.start: right hand rises to head height
phases.middle: hand swings side to side repeatedly

kicking_something.text: a person swings one leg forward from the hip with force
paraphrases: a person draws the right leg back and then kicks it forward quickly
a person shifts weight onto one foot and swings the other leg forward
a person kicks forward with one foot, then sets it back on the ground
kicking_something.motion: Weight shifts onto the left leg and the right leg draws back with the knee bent. The right leg then swings quickly forward and the knee straightens, the foot rising in front of the body. The arms move out for balance and the foot returns to the ground.

phases.start: weight on left leg, right leg draws back
phases.middle: right leg swings quickly forward

reach_into_pocket.text: a person moves one hand down to the hip and pushes it in
paraphrases: a person brings the right hand to the side of the hip and holds it there
a person lowers one hand to the thigh and moves it slightly in and out
a person slides a hand against the hip briefly then lifts it to the front
reach_into_pocket.motion: The right hand moves from in front of the body down to the side of the right hip or upper thigh. The hand stays there briefly with small movements while the head may tilt down. The hand then comes out and rises to the front of the body.

phases.start: right hand moves down to the hip
phases.middle: hand held at the hip with small movements

hopping.text: a person jumps repeatedly on one foot with the other leg raised
paraphrases: a person bounces up and down on a single leg several times
a person lifts one foot off the floor and hops on the other
a person makes repeated small jumps while standing on one leg only
hopping.motion: One knee bends to lift that foot off the floor and hold it up. The standing leg bends and straightens repeatedly so the whole body moves up and down in small jumps. The arms move out or swing for balance, and at the end the raised foot comes down.

phases.start: one foot lifts off the floor
phases.middle: repeated small jumps on one leg
phases.end: raised foot lowers to the floor

jump_up.text: a person bends both knees and jumps straight up off the floor
paraphrases: a person crouches slightly and springs upward with both feet leaving the ground
a person swings the arms up while jumping vertically on both legs
a person lowers the hips then pushes off with both feet into the air
jump_up.motion: The person bends both knees and hips and the arms swing back. The legs straighten quickly and the arms swing up so the whole body rises and both feet leave the floor. The person lands on both feet with knees bending, then stands upright.

phases.start: knees bend and arms swing back
phases.middle: body rises with both feet off the floor
phases.end: landing on both feet with knees bent

phone_call.text: a person holds one hand still against the side of the head
paraphrases: a person raises the right hand to the ear and keeps it there
a person bends the arm so the hand stays beside the ear for a while
a person lifts one hand to the side of the face and holds it
phone_call.motion: The right arm bends and the right hand rises to the right side of the head next to the ear. The hand stays still there for most of the time, with the elbow pointing down and forward. The head may tilt slightly toward the hand, and the body may shift or walk a little.

phases.start: right hand rises to the ear
phases.middle: hand held still beside the ear

play_with_phone_tablet.text: a person holds both hands together in front of the chest making small movements
paraphrases: a person looks down at hands held close at chest height with small repeated motions
a person keeps the hands together in front with occasional small taps and swipes
a person bows the head toward both hands held in front and moves them slightly
play_with_phone_tablet.motion: Both forearms are raised so the hands are close together in front of the chest. The head tilts down toward the hands. The hands stay mostly in place with small repeated movements of one hand, and the body otherwise stays still.

phases.start: hands rise together in front of the chest
phases.middle: hands held with small repeated movements, head bowed

type_on_a_keyboard.text: a person holds both hands low in front and taps them repeatedly
paraphrases: a person makes small up and down movements with both hands side by side
a person rests two hands low in front and moves them in short taps
a person, often seated, keeps both hands forward at waist level with small movements
type_on_a_keyboard.motion: The person, often seated, holds both forearms forward with the hands side by side at about waist height. Both hands make small, fast up and down movements and occasionally shift sideways. The head is tilted slightly down or forward, and the rest of the body stays still.

phases.start: both hands placed low in front
phases.middle: repeated small taps by both hands

point_to_something.text: a person raises one straight arm and holds it pointing forward or sideways
paraphrases: a person lifts the right arm straight out and holds it extended
a person extends the right arm away from the body and keeps it still
a person stretches one arm out level and briefly holds the pointing pose
point_to_something.motion: The right arm rises from the side of the body and straightens at the elbow until the hand is far in front of or to the side of the shoulder, roughly at shoulder height. The arm is held still in that extended position for a moment while the torso and legs stay mostly still. The arm then lowers back to the side. The motion happens once and does not repeat.

phases.start: arms at sides
phases.middle: right arm straight and held out at shoulder height

taking_a_selfie.text: a person holds one hand up and out in front, facing the face
paraphrases: a person raises the right arm forward and up, hand aimed back at the head
a person lifts one hand above eye level in front and holds it there
a person extends the right arm up in front of the face and pauses
taking_a_selfie.motion: The right arm lifts forward and upward until the hand is in front of and slightly above the head, with the elbow partly bent. The hand stays still in that raised position for a while, sometimes with small adjustments, and the head may tilt slightly toward it. The torso stays upright with little leg motion. The arm then lowers back down.

phases.start: right arm lifts forward and up
phases.middle: hand held still in front of and above the face

check_time_(from_watch).text: a person lifts the left wrist in front of the chest and looks down
paraphrases: a person raises the left forearm horizontally in front of the body briefly
a person brings the left wrist up toward the face and holds it
a person bends the left elbow, lifts the wrist, and tilts the head down
check_time_(from_watch).motion: The left forearm rises and turns so the wrist is held horizontally in front of the chest, with the elbow bent. The head tilts down slightly toward the raised wrist. The pose is held briefly, sometimes with the right hand touching the left wrist, then the left arm lowers back to the side. The action happens once.

phases.start: left forearm lifts
phases.middle: wrist held level in front of chest, head tilted toward it

not_observable: eye gaze at the watch face

rub_two_hands.text: a person rubs both hands together back and forth in front of chest
paraphrases: a person holds both palms together and slides them repeatedly against each other
a person keeps both hands touching in front of the body and moves them
a person brings the hands together at chest level and rubs them repeatedly
rub_two_hands.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest or stomach with the elbows bent. The hands stay in contact and slide back and forth against each other in short repeated strokes. The arms move only at the forearms while the torso and legs stay still. At the end the hands separate and lower.

phases.start: hands meet in front of chest
phases.middle: repeated small back-and-forth rubbing of the hands

not_observable: lotion or cold as a reason

nod_head_bow.text: a person bends the head and upper body forward then straightens up
paraphrases: a person tips the head down and leans the torso forward briefly
a person bows by bending forward at the waist and returning upright
a person lowers the head toward the chest and then lifts it back
nod_head_bow.motion: The head moves forward and down toward the chest, and in a bow the torso also leans forward from the hips. The arms stay mostly at the sides or hang down. After a short pause at the lowest point, the head and torso return to an upright posture. This may happen once or repeat a few times.

phases.start: standing upright
phases.middle: head and torso tilted forward and down

shake_head.text: a person turns the head left and right repeatedly while the body stays still
paraphrases: a person rotates the head side to side several times with a still torso
a person moves the head repeatedly from left to right and back
a person swings the head from one side to the other a few times
shake_head.motion: The head rotates left and right around the neck several times in a row, while the shoulders and torso stay mostly still. The arms remain at the sides. The rotation is small and fast compared to whole-body turning. The head stops facing forward at the end.

phases.start: head facing forward
phases.middle: repeated left-right head rotation

wipe_face.text: a person moves one or both hands over the face in wiping strokes
paraphrases: a person raises the hands to the face and strokes them across it
a person brings the hands up to the head and rubs down the face
a person lifts both hands to the face and moves them over it repeatedly
wipe_face.motion: One or both hands rise from the sides to the face, with the elbows bent and raised in front of the chest. The hands stay at the face and move in up-down or side-to-side strokes, often more than once. The head may tilt slightly forward toward the hands. The hands then lower back down.

phases.start: hands rise to the face
phases.middle: hands stroke across the face repeatedly

not_observable: sweat or water on the face

salute.text: a person raises the right hand to the forehead with the elbow out
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to the brow and holds it briefly
a person bends the right arm so the hand touches near the forehead
a person brings the right hand up beside the head with the elbow sideways
salute.motion: The right arm lifts so that the elbow points out to the side at about shoulder height and the hand comes to rest near the right side of the forehead. The posture is held still for a moment with the body upright and the left arm at the side. The right arm then drops quickly back to the side.

phases.start: standing upright, arms at sides
phases.middle: right hand held at forehead, elbow out to side

put_palms_together.text: a person presses both palms together in front of the chest and holds
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together at the chest and keeps them still
a person joins the hands in front of the body and pauses
a person raises both hands to meet at chest level and holds the pose
put_palms_together.motion: Both hands rise from the sides and meet in front of the center of the chest, with the elbows bent and pointing outward or down. The hands stay pressed together without moving for a while. The head may bow slightly forward. Then the hands separate and lower to the sides.

phases.start: hands rise toward the chest
phases.middle: hands joined and held still at chest center

cross_hands_in_front.text: a person crosses both forearms in an X shape in front of the chest
paraphrases: a person brings both arms across each other in front of the body
a person raises the forearms and overlaps them at the wrists in front
a person makes an X with both arms crossed in front of the torso
cross_hands_in_front.motion: Both arms lift from the sides and the forearms cross each other in front of the chest or face, with each hand ending on the opposite side of the body. The crossed position is held still for a moment. The arms then uncross and lower back to the sides.

phases.start: arms lift toward the center
phases.middle: forearms crossed in an X and held

sneeze_cough.text: a person brings a hand to the mouth while the head jerks forward
paraphrases: a person covers the mouth with one hand and bends the head down sharply
a person lifts a hand to the face as the upper body jolts forward
a person jerks the head and shoulders forward with a hand at the mouth
sneeze_cough.motion: The right hand or both hands rise quickly to the front of the mouth, with the elbow bent in front of the chest. The head and upper torso jerk forward and down in one or several short sudden movements. The hand stays near the mouth during the jerks, then the body straightens and the hand lowers.

phases.start: hand rises to the mouth
phases.middle: sudden forward jerk of head and torso, may repeat

staggering.text: a person walks unsteadily with the body swaying from side to side
paraphrases: a person takes uneven steps while the torso tilts left and right
a person moves forward with irregular steps and an unbalanced swaying body
a person stumbles along with arms out and the upper body wobbling
staggering.motion: The person takes several uneven steps, with the feet landing at irregular spacing and sometimes crossing. The torso and head sway from side to side and forward and back, and the hip shifts with each step. The arms may move out from the body to keep balance. The whole body travels a short distance in a wavering path.

phases.start: body begins to sway
phases.middle: irregular steps with side-to-side torso lean
phases.end: body slows and regains balance or stops

not_observable: dizziness or intoxication as the cause

falling_down.text: a person drops from standing to the floor, ending low on the ground
paraphrases: a person collapses downward with the hips and torso sinking to the floor
a person loses balance and goes down until the body is near the ground
a person sinks from an upright posture to sitting or lying on the floor
falling_down.motion: From standing, the knees bend and the hip moves rapidly downward, often with the torso tilting forward or sideways. The hands may reach toward the floor to break the fall. The body ends with the hip and torso very low, on the knees, sitting, or lying, and stays down. The movement happens once and is faster than sitting down.

phases.start: standing, balance lost
phases.middle: rapid downward drop of hip and torso

headache.text: a person holds one or both hands against the head with head tilted
paraphrases: a person presses a hand on the forehead and lowers the head slightly
a person raises the hands to the sides of the head and holds them
a person keeps a hand on the head while the head bends forward
headache.motion: One or both hands rise to the forehead or temples, with the elbows bent and raised. The hands stay on the head for a long time, sometimes with small rubbing movements. The head tilts forward or to the side and the shoulders may hunch. The hands then lower.

phases.start: hands rise to the head
phases.middle: hands held on forehead or temples, head tilted

chest_pain.text: a person presses a hand on the chest and leans forward slightly
paraphrases: a person holds one hand flat against the chest with the shoulders hunched
a person clutches the chest with a hand and bends the upper body
a person places both hands on the chest and curls the torso forward
chest_pain.motion: The right hand, sometimes both hands, moves to the center or left of the chest and stays pressed there. The torso bends forward a little and the shoulders round inward, and the head may drop. The posture is held for a while, sometimes with a slight stagger. The hands then lower and the body straightens.

phases.start: hand moves to chest
phases.middle: hand held on chest, torso bent forward

back_pain.text: a person places a hand on the lower back and arches backward
paraphrases: a person reaches one hand behind to the lower back and holds it
a person puts both hands on the back of the waist and leans
a person holds the lower back with a hand behind the body
back_pain.motion: The right hand, often both, moves behind the body to rest on the lower back near the hips, with the elbows pointing backward and out. The torso leans back or bends slightly forward and may twist. The hands stay on the back for a while. Then the hands come forward and lower.

phases.start: hands move behind the body
phases.middle: hands held on lower back, torso arched or bent

neck_pain.text: a person holds a hand on the back of the neck, tilting head
paraphrases: a person raises one hand behind the neck and keeps it there
a person rubs the back of the neck with one hand and bends the head
a person lifts a hand to the neck and rolls the head slightly
neck_pain.motion: The right hand rises and reaches behind the head to the back of the neck, with the elbow bent and pointing forward or up. The hand stays there, sometimes making small rubbing motions. The head tilts forward, back, or to the side, and may rotate slowly. The hand then lowers.

phases.start: hand rises behind the head
phases.middle: hand on back of neck, head tilting

nausea_vomiting.text: a person bends forward at the waist with a hand at mouth or stomach
paraphrases: a person leans the torso far forward and holds a hand at the mouth
a person doubles over with a hand on the belly and head lowered
a person hunches forward and down with the head dropped toward the floor
nausea_vomiting.motion: The torso bends forward from the hips and the head drops down and forward. One hand moves to the mouth or the stomach, and the other may rest on the knee or hang down. The upper body may jerk forward a few times while bent. The bent posture is held for a while before the person straightens.

phases.start: hand moves to mouth or stomach
phases.middle: torso bent far forward, head low, possible jerks

fan_self.text: a person waves one hand back and forth in front of the face
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand repeatedly near the face in short swings
a person flaps one hand toward the face several times in a row
a person holds a hand in front of the face and swings it quickly
fan_self.motion: The right hand rises to in front of the face or neck, with the elbow bent in front of the chest. The hand and forearm swing quickly back and forth toward and away from the face, many times, with the motion mostly at the wrist and elbow. The torso and head stay still. The hand then lowers.

phases.start: hand rises in front of face
phases.middle: rapid repeated small swings toward the face

punch_slap.text: a person swings an arm to strike another person's head or upper body
paraphrases: a person thrusts a fist toward another person's face, who flinches back
a person hits another person with a fast swing of the right arm
two people stand close as one swings a hand quickly at the other's head
punch_slap.motion: The actor stands facing the partner and draws the right arm back, then swings or thrusts it quickly forward so the hand reaches the partner's head or chest. The actor's torso may rotate and lean into the strike. The partner's head and upper body jerk back or turn away at the moment of contact, and the partner may raise an arm to protect. The actor's arm then pulls back.

phases.start: two people face each other, actor draws arm back
phases.middle: fast arm swing reaches partner's head, partner recoils

kicking.text: a person swings one leg forward to kick another person standing in front
paraphrases: a person lifts the right foot quickly toward another person's body
two people face each other as one kicks the other with a leg
a person kicks forward at another person, who steps or bends back
kicking.motion: The actor stands facing the partner, shifts weight onto the left leg, and swings the right leg forward and up so the foot reaches the partner's legs or torso. The actor's arms may move out for balance and the torso leans back slightly. The partner's body jerks back or bends at the point of contact and may step backward. The actor's leg then returns to the floor.

phases.start: two people face each other, actor shifts weight
phases.middle: actor's leg swings forward into partner, partner recoils
phases.end: actor's foot returns to the floor

pushing.text: a person pushes another person's chest with both hands, moving them backward
paraphrases: a person thrusts both arms forward into another person, who steps back
two people face each other and one shoves the other away with hands
a person extends both arms against another person's upper body and pushes
pushing.motion: The actor faces the partner, bends both elbows, then extends both arms forward quickly so the hands contact the partner's chest or shoulders. The actor's torso leans forward behind the push. The partner's torso tilts back and the partner takes one or more steps backward, increasing the distance between them. The actor's arms then lower.

phases.start: two people close together facing each other
phases.middle: actor's arms extend into partner's chest

pat_on_back.text: a person taps another person's back or shoulder repeatedly with one hand
paraphrases: a person reaches an arm around another person and pats their back
two people stand side by side while one taps the other's shoulder
a person lightly hits another person's upper back several times with a hand
pat_on_back.motion: The actor stands beside or slightly behind the partner and raises the right arm so the hand reaches the partner's upper back or shoulder. The hand moves up and down in small repeated taps while the actor's arm stays bent. The partner stands mostly still with little body movement. The actor's arm then lowers.

phases.start: actor beside or behind partner, arm lifts
phases.middle: repeated small taps on partner's back or shoulder

point_finger.text: a person points a straight arm at another person standing in front
paraphrases: a person extends the right arm toward another person's face and holds
two people face each other as one aims a straight arm at the other
a person raises one arm and holds it extended toward another person
point_finger.motion: The actor faces the partner and lifts the right arm forward until it is straight, with the hand aimed at the partner's face or chest. The arm is held extended and may jab forward a few times. The partner stands mostly still or leans back slightly. The actor's arm then lowers.

phases.start: two people facing each other
phases.middle: actor's straight arm held toward partner

hugging.text: two people step together and wrap their arms around each other's bodies
paraphrases: two people embrace with arms around each other's backs and chests close
a person and another person hold each other closely with both arms
two people move in close and put their arms around one another
hugging.motion: Both people move toward each other until their torsos are very close or touching. Each raises both arms and wraps them around the other's back or shoulders, so their hands end behind the other person's body. They hold the embrace for a while with little movement, possibly swaying slightly. They then release and step apart.

phases.start: two people approach each other
phases.middle: arms wrapped around each other, torsos together

giving_object.text: a person extends a hand to another person, who reaches out to take it
paraphrases: a person holds out the right hand and another person's hand meets it
two people reach toward each other until their hands meet, then withdraw
a person passes something forward as another person reaches and receives it
giving_object.motion: The actor extends the right arm forward toward the partner at about waist or chest height. The partner raises a hand and reaches forward so both hands meet between them briefly. Then both arms pull back, with the partner's hand returning toward their own body. The action happens once.

phases.start: two people facing each other, actor's arm extends
phases.middle: both hands meet between them

touch_pocket.text: a person reaches a hand toward another person's hip or pocket area
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand to the side of another person's waist
two people stand close as one reaches toward the other's pocket
a person sneaks a hand toward another person's hip from beside them
touch_pocket.motion: The actor stands beside or behind the partner and moves the right hand down and toward the partner's hip, where it stays briefly. The actor's torso may lean slightly toward the partner. The partner mostly stands still, or turns and looks back and moves a hand toward the hip. The actor's hand then withdraws.

phases.start: actor beside or behind partner
phases.middle: actor's hand at partner's hip

shaking_hands.text: two people join right hands between them and move them up and down
paraphrases: two people face each other and clasp right hands, shaking them briefly
a person takes another person's right hand and moves it up and down
two people reach out right hands, join them, and pump a few times
shaking_hands.motion: Both people face each other and extend their right arms forward so their right hands meet in the space between them at about waist height. The joined hands move up and down a few times together. Their torsos stay upright and close. Then the hands release and both arms return to their sides.

phases.start: two people facing, right arms extend
phases.middle: joined right hands move up and down

walking_towards.text: two people walk toward each other from a distance until they are close
paraphrases: two people approach each other with walking steps and stop near each other
a person and another person walk forward and meet in the middle
two people start apart and step closer together until face to face
walking_towards.motion: The two people start apart and both walk forward with alternating leg steps and arm swings, facing each other. The distance between their bodies shrinks steadily. They stop when they are close and facing each other. The torsos stay upright throughout.

phases.start: two people apart, facing each other
phases.middle: both walking forward, distance shrinking

walking_apart.text: two people start close together and walk away from each other
paraphrases: two people turn and walk in opposite directions, getting farther apart
a person and another person separate by walking away from one another
two people step away from each other until there is a large gap
walking_apart.motion: The two people start close together, then turn away from each other and walk with alternating leg steps and arm swings. Each moves in roughly the opposite direction, so the distance between their bodies grows steadily. They stop or leave the view far apart. The torsos stay upright throughout.

phases.start: two people close together
phases.middle: both walking away, distance growing

put_on_headphone.text: a person lifts both hands over the head then brings them down to the ears
paraphrases: a person raises both hands above the head and lowers them onto the ears
a person brings both hands up over the head and settles them at the ears
a person lifts both arms, then lowers both hands to the sides of the head
put_on_headphone.motion: Both hands rise together from in front of the chest to the top of the head, with the elbows bending out to the sides. The hands then move down symmetrically to the sides of the head near the ears and stay there briefly with small adjusting movements. Finally both arms lower back to the sides of the body while the head and torso stay mostly still and upright.

phases.start: both hands rise in front of the chest
phases.middle: hands pass over the head and come down to the ears
phases.end: hands leave the ears and the arms lower

not_observable: fitting the ear cups over the ears

take_off_headphone.text: a person lifts both hands to the ears and raises them away over the head
paraphrases: a person raises both hands from the ears up and off the head
a person holds the sides of the head and lifts both hands upward and away
a person moves both hands from the ears over the head and then down
take_off_headphone.motion: Both arms rise so that the hands reach the sides of the head near the ears. The hands then move upward together over the top of the head, with the elbows spreading outward. The hands come down in front of the body close to each other at chest or waist height, and the arms lower.

phases.start: both hands rise to the ears
phases.middle: hands lift up over the head
phases.end: hands come down together in front of the body

shoot_at_basket.text: a person raises both hands above the head and pushes them upward and forward
paraphrases: a person bends the knees, then extends both arms upward and forward from the chest
a person brings both hands up past the face and extends the arms high forward
a person dips slightly then straightens the legs while both arms push up forward
shoot_at_basket.motion: The person starts with both hands together in front of the chest and bends the knees slightly. The legs straighten while both hands rise past the face to above the head, and the arms extend upward and forward with the right arm leading. The wrists bend forward at the end, the arms stay raised briefly, and then they lower; the heels may lift during the push.

phases.start: hands together at the chest, knees bent
phases.middle: legs straighten as both arms push up and forward

bounce_ball.text: a person repeatedly pushes one hand down and up beside the hip
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand up and down repeatedly at waist height
a person pats downward at waist level again and again with one hand
a person leans slightly forward and pumps one hand down and up repeatedly
bounce_ball.motion: The person stands with the torso tilted slightly forward and the right hand held in front of or beside the right hip. The right hand and forearm push down and come back up in a steady repeated rhythm, with the wrist and elbow bending each time. The left arm stays mostly still, and the knees may bend slightly throughout.

phases.start: slight forward lean with the right hand at the waist
phases.middle: right hand pushes down and rises repeatedly
phases.end: hand stops and the torso straightens

tennis_bat_swing.text: a person swings the right arm across the body from back to front
paraphrases: a person rotates the torso and sweeps one arm forward in a wide arc
a person draws the right arm back then swings it forward across the body
a person turns the shoulders and swings an extended arm sideways in front
tennis_bat_swing.motion: The person turns the torso to the right and pulls the right arm back behind the body. The torso then rotates to the left while the extended right arm sweeps forward in a wide, roughly horizontal arc across the front of the body. The arm finishes on the left side near the left shoulder, and the weight shifts from the back leg to the front leg.

phases.start: torso turned right, right arm drawn back
phases.middle: arm sweeps forward across the body as the torso rotates
phases.end: arm finishes near the left shoulder

juggle_table_tennis_ball.text: a person holds one forearm forward and makes small repeated up and down hand movements
paraphrases: a person repeatedly lifts and drops the right hand slightly in front of the chest
a person keeps the right forearm forward and taps upward with small repeated motions
a person makes small quick vertical hand movements with the forearm held in front
juggle_table_tennis_ball.motion: The right forearm is held forward at waist to chest height with the elbow bent close to the body. The right hand moves up and down in small, quick, repeated motions, mainly from the wrist and elbow. The head may tilt slightly down and the rest of the body stays mostly still, though the person may take small steps.

phases.start: right forearm raised forward
phases.middle: small repeated up and down hand motions

hush.text: a person raises one hand to the front of the mouth and holds it
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to the lips and keeps it there briefly
a person brings a raised hand up to the center of the face and pauses
a person moves the right hand up in front of the mouth then lowers it
hush.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises from the side to the front of the mouth, close to the center of the face. The hand stays there briefly with little movement, sometimes while the head tilts slightly forward. The hand then lowers back to the side of the body.

phases.start: right hand rises from the side
phases.middle: hand held still in front of the mouth

not_observable: index finger extended over the lips

flick_hair.text: a person raises one hand to the side of the head and sweeps it backward
paraphrases: a person brushes the right hand from the forehead back over the head
a person lifts a hand to the head and pushes it back quickly once
a person moves one hand to the temple and flicks it back past the ear
flick_hair.motion: The right hand rises to the forehead or the side of the head. It moves quickly backward along the side of the head past the ear, often with a small tilt or turn of the head to the opposite side. The hand then drops back down; the motion is short and happens once or twice.

phases.start: right hand rises to the forehead
phases.middle: hand sweeps quickly back past the ear with a head tilt

thumb_up.text: a person raises one closed hand forward at chest height and holds it still
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand in front of the chest and keeps it there
a person extends the right forearm forward with a closed hand and pauses
a person brings one hand up in front of the body and holds it briefly
thumb_up.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to chest or shoulder height in front of the body, often pushed slightly forward. The hand is held still for a moment with the thumb tip above the hand. The arm then lowers back to the side.

phases.start: right hand rises in front of the body
phases.middle: hand held still at chest height with the thumb up

thumb_down.text: a person raises one closed hand in front of the chest, wrist turned down
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand forward and holds it with the thumb pointing down
a person extends the right forearm forward, turns the wrist over, and pauses
a person brings one hand up in front and holds it upside down
thumb_down.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to chest height in front of the body, sometimes pushed forward. The wrist turns so the thumb tip points below the hand, and the hand is held still for a moment. The arm then lowers back to the side.

phases.start: right hand rises in front of the body
phases.middle: wrist turned over, hand held with the thumb down

make_OK_sign.text: a person raises the right hand to shoulder height in front and holds it still
paraphrases: a person lifts one hand beside the face and keeps it raised briefly
a person brings the right hand up to shoulder level and pauses with it
a person holds the right hand up near the face, then lowers it
make_OK_sign.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to shoulder or face height, in front of or slightly to the side of the body. The hand is held still for a moment, upright with the palm facing forward. The arm then lowers back to the side while the rest of the body stays still.

phases.start: right hand rises from the side
phases.middle: hand held still at shoulder height

not_observable: thumb and index finger forming a ring

make_victory_sign.text: a person raises the right hand near the face and holds it upright
paraphrases: a person lifts one hand to head height with fingers up and pauses
a person brings the right hand up beside the face and keeps it still
a person holds an upright hand raised near the shoulder, then lowers it
make_victory_sign.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises to shoulder or head height, beside or in front of the face. The hand is held upright and still for a moment, with the hand tip above the wrist. The arm then lowers back to the side; the head may tilt slightly toward the hand.

phases.start: right hand rises from the side
phases.middle: upright hand held still near the face

not_observable: index and middle fingers spread in a V shape

staple_book.text: a person presses the right hand down repeatedly on top of the left hand
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together in front and pushes down with the right hand
a person holds the hands together at waist level and presses down with one palm
a person pushes the right hand downward on the left hand once or twice
staple_book.motion: Both hands come together in front of the body at waist or table height, with the left hand below and the right hand on top. The right hand and arm push sharply downward, sometimes with the shoulders and torso leaning over the hands, and the press may repeat a few times. Between presses the hands shift slightly, then both hands lower.

phases.start: both hands meet in front at waist height
phases.middle: right hand presses sharply down on the left

counting_money.text: a person holds both hands together in front and moves one hand repeatedly
paraphrases: a person keeps both hands close at chest height and makes small repeated hand motions
a person holds the left hand still and repeatedly moves the right hand across it
a person makes small repeated sliding motions of one hand over the other hand
counting_money.motion: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest or waist, with the left hand mostly still. The right hand makes small repeated movements across or away from the left hand, mainly at the wrist, in a steady rhythm. The head tilts slightly down and the arms and torso stay mostly still.

phases.start: both hands brought together in front
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated motions over the left

cutting_nails.text: a person holds one hand still while the other hand works closely on its fingers
paraphrases: a person brings both hands together near the chest and moves one in small pinches
a person keeps the hands close at chest height, one making small squeezing motions
a person bends the head down over both hands held close and moving slightly
cutting_nails.motion: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest or waist, and the head bends down toward them. The right hand makes small repeated squeezing motions near the fingertips of the left hand, and the left hand may turn or shift slightly between cuts. The arms stay bent and the body stays still; the hands may switch roles partway.

phases.start: hands come together in front, head bends down
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated squeezes at the left fingertips

cutting_paper.text: a person holds both hands apart in front while one hand makes repeated snipping motions
paraphrases: a person holds the left hand forward and moves the right hand along it repeatedly
a person keeps both hands in front of the chest and makes small cutting motions
a person advances the right hand slowly forward with small repeated squeezing motions
cutting_paper.motion: Both hands are raised in front of the chest a short distance apart, with the left hand mostly holding still. The right hand makes small repeated wrist and forearm motions while slowly moving forward or around near the left hand, and the left hand may turn. The head tilts down toward the hands and the body stays still.

phases.start: both hands raised in front of the chest
phases.middle: right hand makes small repeated motions while advancing

snap_fingers.text: a person raises one hand in front and makes a quick small flick with it
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to chest height and gives a sharp flick
a person brings one hand up and makes a short quick wrist motion
a person holds the right hand raised and gives a sudden small downward flick
snap_fingers.motion: The right arm bends and the right hand rises to chest or shoulder height in front of or beside the body. The hand makes one or a few short, quick movements, mostly at the wrist, with little arm movement. The rest of the body stays still and the arm then lowers.

phases.start: right hand rises in front
phases.middle: one or a few quick wrist flicks

open_bottle.text: a person holds both hands together in front and twists one hand repeatedly
paraphrases: a person holds the left hand still and turns the right hand above it
a person brings both hands together at chest height and rotates the upper hand
a person twists the right wrist back and forth above the left hand in front
open_bottle.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest or waist, one above the other, with the left hand lower and still. The right hand twists back and forth with repeated wrist rotations, and the right elbow may lift slightly to the side. Finally the right hand moves up and away from the left hand.

phases.start: hands meet one above the other in front
phases.middle: right wrist twists back and forth repeatedly
phases.end: right hand lifts away from the left

sniff_smell.text: a person brings one hand up close to the nose and holds it there
paraphrases: a person raises the right hand to the face and leans the head toward it
a person lifts a hand under the nose and pauses with the head bent slightly
a person moves one hand to the front of the nose, then lowers it
sniff_smell.motion: The right hand rises to just below or in front of the nose, and the head bends slightly forward or down toward it. The hand and head stay close together for a moment, with possible small head movements. The hand then lowers back to the side; sometimes both hands rise together to the face.

phases.start: right hand rises toward the face
phases.middle: hand held at the nose with the head bent toward it

squat_down.text: a person bends both knees deeply and lowers the hips toward the floor
paraphrases: a person lowers the body into a crouch by bending the legs fully
a person squats, bringing the hips down near the heels with the torso upright
a person crouches low with knees bent and arms often reaching forward
squat_down.motion: Starting from standing, both knees and hips bend and the hips move straight down toward the heels while the feet stay in place. The torso leans slightly forward and the arms often reach forward or rest on the knees for balance. The person holds the low crouch and may then stand back up.

phases.start: standing upright
phases.middle: knees and hips bend, hips drop toward the heels
phases.end: held low crouch, possibly rising again

toss_a_coin.text: a person flicks the right hand upward from chest height and catches with both hands
paraphrases: a person makes a quick upward flick of one hand then brings hands together
a person jerks the right hand up in front, then cups both hands together
a person gives a short upward hand flick, then the hands meet below it
toss_a_coin.motion: The right hand is held in front of the chest or waist with the elbow bent. It makes one short, quick upward flick, mainly at the wrist and forearm, and the head may tilt up slightly. The hand then moves to catch, often with the left hand coming under or over the right hand in front of the body.

phases.start: right hand held in front with the elbow bent
phases.middle: quick upward flick of the right hand
phases.end: hands come together in front to catch

fold_paper.text: a person brings both hands together in front, then presses one along the other
paraphrases: a person moves both hands toward each other at waist height and presses down
a person brings the hands together, then slides one hand flat across the other
a person bends over hands held low in front and repeatedly brings them together
fold_paper.motion: Both hands are held in front of the body at waist or table height, a short distance apart. One hand moves over toward the other, the hands meet, and then one hand slides or presses flat along a line with a slight downward push. This may repeat two or three times, with the head bent down toward the hands.

phases.start: hands apart in front at waist height
phases.middle: one hand moves onto the other and presses along a line

ball_up_paper.text: a person squeezes both hands together repeatedly, turning them around each other in front
paraphrases: a person presses both hands together and rotates them around each other repeatedly
a person brings both hands together at chest height and kneads them in small turns
a person squeezes the hands toward each other again and again in front
ball_up_paper.motion: Both hands start apart in front of the chest and move toward each other until they nearly touch. The hands then press together repeatedly and turn around each other, with the space between them shrinking. At the end the hands hold a compact position close together and then lower, or one hand moves away.

phases.start: hands apart in front of the chest
phases.middle: hands press together and turn around each other repeatedly
phases.end: hands held compact together, then lowered

play_magic_cube.text: a person holds both hands together in front and twists them repeatedly in turns
paraphrases: a person keeps both hands close at chest height and rotates the wrists repeatedly
a person repeatedly turns one hand and then the other while holding them together
a person makes small alternating twisting motions with both hands held in front
play_magic_cube.motion: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest with the elbows bent and the head tilted down toward them. The wrists rotate in short repeated turns, sometimes one hand and sometimes both, while the hands stay at about the same distance apart. The arms and torso stay mostly still for the whole action.

phases.start: hands brought together in front of the chest
phases.middle: repeated short wrist turns of one or both hands

apply_cream_on_face.text: a person rubs both hands in small circles on the cheeks and face
paraphrases: a person moves the fingertips repeatedly over the face in small rubbing motions
a person raises both hands to the face and rubs them around the cheeks
a person touches the face with one or both hands and rubs it repeatedly
apply_cream_on_face.motion: One or both hands rise to the face, often after the hands meet briefly in front of the chest. The hands rub in small repeated circular motions on the cheeks, forehead, and chin, moving between different parts of the face. The head stays mostly still or tilts slightly, and the hands then lower.

phases.start: hands meet in front of the chest, then rise
phases.middle: small repeated circles on different parts of the face

apply_cream_on_hand.text: a person rubs one hand over the back and palm of the other hand
paraphrases: a person moves the right hand around the left hand in repeated rubbing motions
a person holds the hands together in front and rubs them over each other
a person smooths one hand repeatedly over the other hand at chest height
apply_cream_on_hand.motion: Both hands come together in front of the chest or waist. The right hand rubs over the back and palm of the left hand in repeated sliding and circular motions, and then the hands may switch roles. The head tilts slightly down and the arms and torso stay mostly still.

phases.start: hands come together in front
phases.middle: one hand rubs over the other repeatedly, possibly switching

put_on_bag.text: a person reaches each arm back behind the shoulders in turn, then pulls forward
paraphrases: a person passes one arm and then the other back behind the shoulders
a person lifts the hands to the shoulders, bends the arms back, and straightens up
a person moves each arm back behind the body in turn, then adjusts the shoulders
put_on_bag.motion: The person first reaches down or forward with both hands and lifts them to chest height. The right arm bends and moves back behind the right shoulder, then the left arm reaches back behind the left shoulder while the torso twists slightly. Finally the hands rise to the front of the shoulders and pull down, and the shoulders shrug or the torso bounces once.

phases.start: hands lift from low in front to the chest
phases.middle: one arm then the other moves back behind the shoulders
phases.end: hands pull down at the front of the shoulders

take_off_bag.text: a person slides the arms back out behind the shoulders and lowers the hands forward
