paraphrases: a person pulls one arm then the other out from behind the back
a person reaches to the shoulders, slips the arms backward, and brings the hands down
a person moves each arm back behind the shoulder in turn, then lowers both hands
take_off_bag.motion: The hands rise to the front of the shoulders, then the right shoulder drops and the right arm moves back and down out from behind the body. The torso twists slightly as the left hand reaches toward the right side or the left arm slides out behind. The hands come together in front or at one side and lower toward the floor.

phases.start: hands rise to the front of the shoulders
phases.middle: one arm then the other slides back and out with a torso twist
phases.end: hands come together low in front or to the side

put_object_into_bag.text: a person lowers the right hand beside the left hand and pushes it downward
paraphrases: a person brings the right hand from the chest down next to the left hand
a person holds one hand steady low and moves the other hand down into it
a person bends slightly and pushes one hand downward near the other, then withdraws it
put_object_into_bag.motion: The left hand holds still at waist height or lower, in front of or to the side of the body, sometimes with the torso bending slightly forward. The right hand starts higher in front of the chest and moves down to the left hand, pushing in and down. The right hand then comes back up a little and both hands lower.

phases.start: right hand held at chest height, left hand low
phases.middle: right hand moves down and pushes in beside the left hand
phases.end: right hand withdraws and both hands lower

take_object_out_of_bag.text: a person reaches one hand down beside the other hand and lifts it up
paraphrases: a person pushes the right hand down near the left hand, then raises it
a person holds one hand low and draws the other hand up out of it
a person bends slightly, reaches down beside the other hand, and lifts the hand up
take_object_out_of_bag.motion: The left hand holds still at waist height or lower, sometimes with the torso bending slightly forward. The right hand moves down to the left hand, stays there briefly with small searching movements, then lifts up to chest height in front of the body. The right hand may stay raised in front of the chest at the end.

phases.start: left hand held low, right hand moves down to it
phases.middle: right hand stays low with small searching movements
phases.end: right hand lifts to chest height

open_a_box.text: a person holds both hands low in front and pulls them apart outward
paraphrases: a person moves both hands apart at waist height in front of the body
a person bends forward slightly and spreads both hands outward over a low point
a person uses both hands in front of the hips to pull something open
open_a_box.motion: Both hands come together in front of the waist or lower, with the torso leaning slightly forward and the head tilted down. The hands then move apart sideways and slightly upward, sometimes repeated for each side. The legs stay mostly still and the torso returns to upright at the end.

phases.start: both hands reach to a point in front of the waist
phases.middle: hands pull apart sideways and upward

move_heavy_objects.text: a person bends down and drags or pushes something low with both hands
paraphrases: a person crouches, holds a low point with both hands, and leans to shift it
a person squats with both arms down and pulls backward with body weight
a person bends at the hips and moves both hands low while stepping
move_heavy_objects.motion: The person bends at the hips and knees so both hands reach near the floor in front. Both arms stay low and close together while the torso leans to push or pull, often with small steps of the feet sideways or backward. The body stays low through the middle and rises toward upright at the end.

phases.start: bends down and places both hands low
phases.middle: leans and shifts body weight with small steps

shake_fist.text: a person raises the right hand and shakes it in short strokes
paraphrases: a person lifts the right fist near the head and jerks it repeatedly
a person holds the right arm bent up and moves the fist back and forth
a person shakes a raised right fist in short repeated motions toward the front
shake_fist.motion: The right arm bends and lifts so the hand is at shoulder or head height in front of the body. The right hand then moves in short, quick back-and-forth or up-and-down strokes, repeated several times, while the elbow stays bent. The rest of the body stays mostly still and the arm lowers at the end.

phases.start: right arm lifts with elbow bent
phases.middle: hand moves in short repeated strokes

throw_up_cap_hat.text: a person takes something from the head and tosses it upward with one hand
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand from the head and flings it upward
a person grabs at the top of the head then throws the arm upward
a person tosses something high into the air after removing it from the head
throw_up_cap_hat.motion: The right hand rises to the top of the head, then the arm swings forward and upward quickly until it is extended above the head. The head and torso may tilt back slightly to follow the upward throw. The arm then lowers, sometimes with both hands rising again as if to catch.

phases.start: right hand reaches to the top of the head
phases.middle: arm swings fast upward above the head
phases.end: arm lowers or both hands rise to catch

capitulate.text: a person raises both hands up beside the head as in surrender
paraphrases: a person lifts both arms with bent elbows so hands are at head height
a person puts both hands up near the head and holds them still
a person surrenders by raising both hands to the sides of the head
capitulate.motion: Both arms lift together from the sides, elbows bent, until the hands are beside or slightly above the head. The hands are held still in this position for a while. The torso and legs stay upright and still, and the arms may lower at the end.

phases.start: both arms rise from the sides
phases.middle: hands held still beside the head

cross_arms.text: a person folds both arms across the chest and holds them there
paraphrases: a person crosses the forearms in front of the chest and stays still
a person brings each hand to the opposite upper arm across the chest
a person stands with arms folded over the chest in a held pose
cross_arms.motion: Both arms bend and move toward the center of the chest, with each hand going toward the opposite elbow or upper arm. The forearms overlap horizontally against the chest and stay there with little motion. The rest of the body stays upright and still.

phases.start: arms bend toward the chest
phases.middle: forearms cross and rest over the chest
phases.end: held still in the folded pose

arm_circles.text: a person stretches both arms out to the sides and rotates them in circles
paraphrases: a person holds arms straight sideways and moves them around in repeated loops
a person swings both outstretched arms in round circles from the shoulders
a person circles both straight arms repeatedly while standing still
arm_circles.motion: Both arms lift out to the sides to about shoulder height and stay straight. The hands trace repeated circles around the shoulders, forward or backward, with both arms moving together. The torso and legs stay still while the circling continues several times before the arms drop.

phases.start: arms lift straight out to the sides
phases.middle: hands trace repeated circles around the shoulders

arm_swings.text: a person swings both straight arms back and forth across the body repeatedly
paraphrases: a person moves both arms in big repeated swings in front of the chest
a person opens arms out wide then swings them across the chest repeatedly
a person swings the arms forward and backward over and over while standing
arm_swings.motion: Both arms stay mostly straight and swing together, either opening out to the sides and then crossing in front of the chest, or swinging forward and back past the hips. The movement repeats rhythmically many times. The torso may twist slightly with the swings while the legs stay planted.

phases.start: arms lift and open
phases.middle: arms swing across the body or back and forth repeatedly
phases.end: arms come to rest at the sides

run_on_the_spot.text: a person jogs in place, lifting knees alternately while arms swing
paraphrases: a person runs without moving forward, raising each foot in turn quickly
a person alternately lifts left and right legs fast while staying in place
a person pumps bent arms and lifts the knees in a running rhythm
run_on_the_spot.motion: The legs alternate quickly, with each knee lifting forward and the foot leaving the ground while the other foot supports the body. The bent arms swing forward and back opposite to the legs. The whole body bounces slightly up and down in rhythm but stays in the same spot.

phases.start: first knee lifts and arms start pumping
phases.middle: fast alternating leg lifts with arm swings

butt_kicks.text: a person jogs in place kicking each heel back toward the buttocks
paraphrases: a person alternately bends each knee to bring the heel up behind
a person raises the feet behind the body one after another in place
a person flicks each lower leg backward so the heel nears the hip
butt_kicks.motion: The legs alternate, each knee bending so the foot moves backward and upward until the heel is near the buttocks, while the thigh stays mostly vertical. The other leg supports the body and the movement repeats quickly in place. The arms may swing bent at the sides or rest on the hips.

phases.start: first heel kicks back
phases.middle: heels alternate up behind quickly
phases.end: both feet back on the ground

cross_toe_touch.text: a person bends forward and touches each hand to the opposite foot alternately
paraphrases: a person twists and reaches the right hand toward the left foot, then switches
a person bends down diagonally so one hand meets the opposite toes repeatedly
a person alternately reaches each hand down across the body to the other foot
cross_toe_touch.motion: Starting with the feet apart and arms out, the person bends at the hips and twists the torso so the right hand reaches down to the left foot. The torso rises back up and then the left hand reaches down to the right foot. This crossing bend repeats several times on alternating sides.

phases.start: stands with feet apart and arms out
phases.middle: bends and twists so a hand reaches the opposite foot, alternating sides

side_kick.text: a person lifts one leg and kicks it out sideways from the hip
paraphrases: a person extends the right leg straight out to the side and pulls it back
a person leans away and thrusts one foot sideways at hip height
a person kicks sideways with one leg while the torso tilts the other way
side_kick.motion: The weight shifts onto the left leg and the right knee lifts. The right leg then extends quickly out to the side with the foot leading, while the torso tilts toward the left to balance. The leg pulls back and the foot returns to the ground, sometimes repeated.

phases.start: weight shifts to one leg and the other knee lifts
phases.middle: leg extends out to the side
phases.end: leg pulls back and foot lands

yawn.text: a person raises one hand to the mouth and tilts the head back briefly
paraphrases: a person covers the mouth with the right hand while the head tips back
a person lifts a hand to the face and stretches the neck slightly upward
a person brings the right hand to the mouth with a slow backward head tilt
yawn.motion: The right hand rises slowly to the front of the mouth and stays there briefly. The head tilts slightly back and the shoulders and chest may lift, sometimes with the arms stretching a little. The hand then lowers and the head returns to level.

phases.start: hand rises toward the mouth
phases.middle: hand held at the mouth with head tilted back

stretch_oneself.text: a person raises both arms overhead and extends the body upward, then relaxes
paraphrases: a person lifts both arms high above the head and lengthens the torso
a person pushes both hands upward with the chest lifting and back arching
a person reaches both arms up and outward to stretch, then lowers them
stretch_oneself.motion: Both arms rise from the sides or front until they are extended above the head, often with the hands close together. The torso straightens and may lean back or to each side while the arms stay up for a moment. The arms then come down and the body relaxes.

phases.start: arms lift up
phases.middle: arms held fully extended overhead with the torso stretched

blow_nose.text: a person brings both hands to the nose and bends the head forward
paraphrases: a person holds both hands over the nose while tilting the head down
a person lifts both hands to the center of the face and wipes the nose
a person covers the nose with both hands and makes small pressing motions
blow_nose.motion: Both hands rise together to the front of the face and meet at the nose. The head tips slightly forward and may jerk a little while the hands stay at the nose, sometimes with small wiping motions. The hands then lower away from the face.

phases.start: hands rise to the nose
phases.middle: hands held at the nose with the head tipped forward

hit_with_object.text: a person swings the right arm down onto another person, who flinches away
paraphrases: a person raises the arm high and strikes down at another person's body
two people face each other as one swings an arm down onto the other
a person hits another person with a downward arm swing as the partner recoils
hit_with_object.motion: The actor faces the partner, lifts the right arm high with the elbow bent, then swings it forward and down toward the partner's head or shoulder. The partner reacts by leaning or stepping back and may raise the arms to shield the head. The swing may repeat once or twice before the actor lowers the arm.

phases.start: actor raises the right arm high toward the partner
phases.middle: arm swings down onto the partner, partner recoils
phases.end: actor lowers the arm, partner shields or steps away

not_observable: the object held in the hand

wield_knife.text: a person thrusts the right hand repeatedly toward another person who backs away
paraphrases: a person makes stabbing or slashing arm motions at another person in front
two people face each other while one jabs an arm forward at the other
a person lunges with the right arm toward another person who retreats defensively
wield_knife.motion: The actor holds the right hand forward at waist or chest height and makes quick thrusts or side-to-side slashes toward the partner, sometimes stepping forward. The partner leans back, steps away, and raises the arms in front of the body to block. The thrusts repeat several times.

phases.start: actor raises the right hand toward the partner
phases.middle: repeated thrusts or slashes, partner backs off with arms up
phases.end: actor pulls the arm back, partner keeps distance

knock_over.text: a person pushes into another person who falls to the ground
paraphrases: a person shoves or trips another person, making the partner fall down
two people collide as one drives forward and the other drops to the floor
a person knocks another person off balance so the partner ends up lying down
knock_over.motion: The actor moves toward the partner and pushes with both arms or bumps with the shoulder or leg. The partner's torso tips backward or sideways, the knees bend, and the partner drops to the ground with the hip and torso ending low. The actor stays standing over the fallen partner.

phases.start: actor approaches the partner
phases.middle: actor shoves, partner loses balance
phases.end: partner lies or sits on the ground, actor stands

grab_stuff.text: a person reaches out and snatches something from another person's hands
paraphrases: a person grabs at another person's hands and pulls back quickly toward the body
two people stand close as one suddenly reaches over and takes from the other
a person yanks something away from another person, who pulls back or reaches after
grab_stuff.motion: The partner holds the hands in front of the body. The actor reaches the right arm quickly toward the partner's hands and then pulls it back sharply toward the actor's own torso. The partner's hands are pulled forward briefly and may then reach after the actor or pull back.

phases.start: partner holds hands in front, actor reaches
phases.middle: actor's hand grips and pulls back sharply
phases.end: actor holds the hand near the body, partner reacts

shoot_with_gun.text: a person points a straight arm at another person, who raises the hands
paraphrases: a person aims the extended right arm at another person who freezes or ducks
two people face each other while one holds an arm straight out at the other
a person holds both hands forward aimed at another person, who recoils
shoot_with_gun.motion: The actor raises the right arm, often supported by the left hand, until it points straight at the partner, and holds it still with small backward jerks. The partner reacts by raising both hands, flinching, falling, or turning away. The actor's arm stays aimed for a while before lowering.

phases.start: actor lifts the arm toward the partner
phases.middle: arm held straight and aimed with small recoil jerks, partner reacts
phases.end: actor lowers the arm, partner has raised hands or fallen

step_on_foot.text: a person lifts a foot and stamps down on another person's foot
paraphrases: a person steps forward and presses one foot onto another person's foot
two people stand close as one brings a foot down onto the other's foot
a person stamps on another person's foot and the partner pulls the leg back
step_on_foot.motion: The actor stands near the partner, lifts the right knee, and brings the foot down hard onto the partner's foot. The partner may lift that foot, bend forward, or step back. The actor then moves the foot away and stands normally.

phases.start: actor lifts a foot near the partner
phases.middle: foot stamps onto the partner's foot, partner flinches

high-five.text: two people raise one hand each and slap palms together above the shoulders
paraphrases: a person lifts a hand high and claps it against another person's raised hand
two people face each other and meet raised hands at head height
two people swing an arm up so their hands touch briefly overhead
high-five.motion: Both people face each other and each raises one arm so the hand is at or above head height. The hands swing toward each other and meet briefly between the two people, then pull back. Both arms then lower while the torsos stay upright.

phases.start: both raise a hand
phases.middle: hands meet between them above the shoulders

cheers_and_drink.text: two people touch raised hands together, then each lifts a hand to the mouth
paraphrases: a person clinks hands with another person at chest height, then both drink
two people bring hands together in front, then raise them to their faces
two people tap their hands together and then tip them toward their mouths
cheers_and_drink.motion: Both people face each other and each extends the right hand forward at chest height until the hands meet briefly in the middle. Each person then pulls the hand back to the mouth, tilting the head slightly back while the hand stays there. The hands lower at the end.

phases.start: both raise hands toward each other
phases.middle: hands meet briefly between them
phases.end: each hand moves to the mouth and the head tilts back

carry_object.text: two people walk together while holding their hands low between them
paraphrases: a person and another person lift and walk with arms extended toward each other
two people move in the same direction with hands held at a shared point
two people bend, lift together, and walk while keeping hands at waist height
carry_object.motion: Both people bend slightly and place their hands at waist or hip height facing each other, then straighten up together. They walk in the same direction, keeping a steady distance apart with their arms held forward or downward toward a shared point. At the end they bend and lower their hands together.

phases.start: both bend and grip low
phases.middle: walk together keeping hands at the same height
phases.end: both lower their hands and release
